name: gri-firebase-scripts
description: Tooling Firebase de GRI: seed idempotente del restaurante demo + firebase-tools (emuladores/deploy). Ver docs/FIREBASE_SETUP.md.

scripts.test:rules: node run_emulators.mjs --only firestore --project demo-gri -- node --test scripts/test/rules/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:functions: node run_emulators.mjs --only auth,functions,firestore --project demo-gri -- node --test scripts/test/functions/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
